title: Intermittent Connectivity and High CPU After Switch Addition
symptoms: Users report intermittent connectivity across the entire floor
Access switches show very high CPU utilization
Broadcast traffic spikes are visible in network monitoring
Issue started after a new unmanaged switch was added to the wiring closet
rootCause: A Layer 2 loop was introduced. STP was disabled on the uplink port of the new switch, or the switch is not participating in STP, causing broadcast frames to loop indefinitely.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the spanning-tree state of all VLANs on a switch?
steps.hint: Look for any interface that should be blocking but is forwarding, or an unexpected root bridge.

steps.prompt: Which command shows interface status to spot flapping or unexpected up ports?
steps.hint: An interface that is up/up but not supposed to be connected is suspicious.

steps.prompt: Which command identifies the current root bridge for VLAN 1?
steps.hint: If a low-priority switch became root by accident, that can cause suboptimal paths but not a loop.
